sentences.text: For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Achintya Anand, Advocate
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Narendra Kumar Singh, APP  Mr. Saroj Kumar Sharma, Advocate  ================

======================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 5 07-01-2025 Heard the parties.

2. The present petition has been preferred for quashing the order taking cognizance dated 03.02.2022 against the petitioners and others by learned Judicial Magistrate 2 nd class, Begusarai in connection with Complaint Case No. 1604(c)/2021 under Section 323, 406 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Since the opposite party no. 2 has already appeared, with the consent of the parties, let the matter go before the Mediation Center where the parties shall remain present on 16.01.2025 and a report be submitted to the Court on 17.02.2025.
4.
In the meantime, interim protection granted to the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34916 of 2023(5) dt.07-01-2025 petitioners vide order dated 21.11.2024 shall continue.
5. The petitioner shall be paying Rs. 5,000/- as a conveyance charge to the lady on the day she will visit the Mediation Center.
